weeks.title: Agent Loop: Difficult Conversation Rehearsal

activities: coaching photo framing with live cues
feeding design references to memory frog
vibe: A careful, design-minded builder who documents failures as honestly as successes and wants agents that help people connect and keep their own authorship.
lines: Each disc in my archive opens a build: its process, saved runs, failures, and reflections.
Memory Frog is a tiny, low-pressure place to feed design references and find them again.
In Our Cognitive Gardens every flower is a classmate's build. Water one if you like it!
My rehearsal agent taught me that a correct action label doesn't mean a correct action.
PAI coaches whoever is holding the phone. The model wasn't the hard part; turning words into hand moves was.
Most of the AI problems were not AI problems. Logs found them, not better prompts.
Stacey and I are proposing ArtSide, a museum companion that adapts when and how it explains.
